thought.text: Login succeeded and the agent portal dashboard renders. Let me verify the remaining pieces: systemd unit contents, removed temp units, daemon process, Perl modules, and that no passwords leaked into logs.

reasoning_content:
Successfully logged in — the agent portal dashboard is now displayed, showing navigation for Tickets, Ticket status, etc. The admin login works with the generated password.

Next, I'll check the remaining items:
1. systemd unit file contents (qisutu-daemon.service) — verify it matches the guide
2. That the temporary units (qisutu-install-complete.path/.service) have been deleted
3. That the daemon is running as the qisutu user (confirmed via ps)
4. The REST API — the guide mentions a REST API, so test the API
5. Check the customer portal (customer login) — though no customer exists
6. Verify that `database-bootstrap.conf` has been deleted (the bootstrap user was deleted after web installation)
7. Check whether the install log doesn't contain the password
8. Verify the perl modules Authen::SASL and Net::LDAP
9. Verify that the system user qisutu belongs to the www-data group
10. Check the state of the systemctl shim

I'll run these checks.

action.command: cat /etc/systemd/system/qisutu-daemon.service; echo '---TEMP UNITS---'; ls /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu; echo '---USER---'; id qisutu; echo '---PERL MODULES---'; perl -MAuthen::SASL -MNet::LDAP -MDBI -e 'print "Perl modules OK: Authen::SASL, Net::LDAP, DBI\n"' 2>&1; echo '---BOOTSTRAP---'; ls /opt/qisutu/var/install/; mysql -u root -e "SELECT user,host FROM mysql.user;" 2>&1
